async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Add New Rule . . .' button to start creating a new promotion
    add_new_rule_button = page.get_by_role("row", name="Shopping Cart Price Rules Add New Rule . . .").get_by_role("button", name="Add New Rule . . .")
    await add_new_rule_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Fill in the rule name
    rule_name_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Rule Name")
    await rule_name_field.fill("Pride Month 45% Off")
    
    # Fill in the description
    description_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description")
    await description_field.fill("45% off on all products for Pride Month")
    
    # Set status to Active
    status_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status")
    await status_combobox.select_option("Active")
    
    # Set websites to Main Website
    websites_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Websites")
    await websites_combobox.select_option("Main Website")
    
    # Set customer groups to General for all customers
    customer_groups_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Customer Groups")
    await customer_groups_combobox.select_option("General")
    
    # Set coupon to No Coupon
    coupon_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Coupon")
    await coupon_combobox.select_option("No Coupon")
    
    # Navigate to the 'Actions' tab to set the discount
    actions_tab = page.get_by_role("tab", name="Actions")
    await actions_tab.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Set the discount amount to 45
    discount_amount_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Discount Amount")
    await discount_amount_field.fill("45")
    
    # Set the discount type to 'Percent of product price discount'
    discount_type_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Discount Type")
    await discount_type_combobox.select_option("Percent of product price discount")
    
    # Save the rule
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")
    await save_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Add New Rule . . .' button to start creating a new promotion
    add_new_rule_button = page.get_by_role("row", name="Shopping Cart Price Rules Add New Rule . . .").get_by_role("button", name="Add New Rule . . .")
    await add_new_rule_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Fill in the rule name
    rule_name_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Rule Name")
    await rule_name_field.fill("Pride Month 45% Off")

    # Fill in the description
    description_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description")
    await description_field.fill("45% off on all products for Pride Month")

    # Set status to Active
    status_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status")
    await status_combobox.select_option("Active")

    # Set websites to Main Website
    websites_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Websites")
    await websites_combobox.select_option("Main Website")

    # Set customer groups to General for all customers
    customer_groups_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Customer Groups")
    await customer_groups_combobox.select_option("General")

    # Set coupon to No Coupon
    coupon_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Coupon")
    await coupon_combobox.select_option("No Coupon")

    # Navigate to the 'Actions' tab to set the discount
    actions_tab = page.get_by_role("tab", name="Actions")
    await actions_tab.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Set the discount amount to 45
    discount_amount_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Discount Amount")
    await discount_amount_field.fill("45")

    # Set the discount type to 'Percent of product price discount'
    discount_type_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Discount Type")
    await discount_type_combobox.select_option("Percent of product price discount")

    # Save the rule
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")
    await save_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
